cat > /app/recover.py << 'EOF'
import struct, zlib, os

blob = open('/app/data.blob','rb').read()
outdir = '/app/recovered'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

pos = 0
idx = 0
TRAILER = 4  # trailing archive checksum
end = len(blob) - TRAILER

while pos + 16 <= end:
    idx += 1
    name_len = struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, pos)[0]; pos += 4
    name = None
    if name_len > 0:
        raw = blob[pos:pos+name_len]
        if len(raw) == name_len and all(32 <= b < 127 for b in raw):
            name = raw.decode()
            pos += name_len
        else:
            print(f'entry {idx}: corrupt name_len={name_len}, stopping')
            break
    # else: name lost to corruption (name_len == 0)
    data_len = struct.unpack_from('<Q', blob, pos)[0]; pos += 8
    fdata = blob[pos:pos+data_len]; pos += data_len
    crc_stored = struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, pos)[0]; pos += 4
    crc_ok = (zlib.crc32(fdata) & 0xffffffff) == crc_stored
    if name is None:
        first = fdata.split(b'\n',1)[0]
        ext = '.csv' if b',' in first else '.bin'
        name = f'recovered_file_{idx}{ext}'
        print(f'entry {idx}: filename lost, using placeholder {name}')
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, name), 'wb') as f:
        f.write(fdata)
    print(f'entry {idx}: {name}  {data_len} bytes  crc={"OK" if crc_ok else "MISMATCH (data corrupted)"}')

print(f'parsed {pos} of {len(blob)} bytes (last {TRAILER} = trailing archive checksum: {blob[-4:].hex()})')
EOF

cat > /app/repair.py << 'EOF'
import zlib, struct

blob = open('/app/data.blob','rb').read()
def crc(b): return zlib.crc32(b) & 0xffffffff

def brute1(data, target):
    data = bytearray(data)
    for i in range(len(data)):
        orig = data[i]
        for v in range(256):
            if v == orig: continue
            data[i] = v
            if crc(data) == target:
                return i, orig, v, bytes(data)
            data[i] = orig
    return None

# schema.sql: data at 0x512, len 368, crc at 0x682
schema = blob[0x512:0x512+368]
t_schema = struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, 0x682)[0]
r = brute1(schema, t_schema)
print('schema single-byte fix:', r[:3] if r else None)
if r:
    open('/app/recovered/schema.sql','wb').write(r[3])
    print('schema.sql repaired')

# config.json: data at 0x1C0, len 155, crc at 0x25B
conf = blob[0x1C0:0x1C0+155]
t_conf = struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, 0x25B)[0]
print('config target crc:', hex(t_conf))
r = brute1(conf, t_conf)
print('config single-byte fix:', r[:3] if r else None)
if r:
    open('/app/recovered/config.json','wb').write(r[3])
    print('config.json repaired (single byte)')
else:
    stripped = conf.rstrip(b'\x00')
    print('crc(stripped to', len(stripped), 'bytes) matches:', crc(stripped) == t_conf)
    print('crc(stripped+newline) matches:', crc(stripped + b'\n') == t_conf)
EOF
